    vector<double> P(MAXN, 0.0);

            if (mask & (1 << j)) {
                sum[mask] = sum[mask ^ (1 << j)] + P[j];
                break;
            }
        }
    }

    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n); ++mask) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (!(mask & (1 << j))) {
                D[mask | (1 << j)] += D[mask] * P[j] / (1.0 - sum[mask]);
